Basculegion.note: Choice Scarf: 214 Speed, locked into its move until it switches out. Adaptability doubles its Water and Ghost moves; Last Respects gains 50 power for each of your fainted Pokémon, so it hits hardest late. Flip Turn brings Pelipper and its rain back in.
Basculegion.src: Most common Jolly spread on the Showdown ladder (21%).

Pelipper.note: Sets rain when it comes in: Water moves do half again as much, and Hurricane never misses (in sun it hits half the time). Weather Ball is a 100-power Water move in rain. Wide Guard blocks spread moves on both of you; Focus Sash keeps it alive through one hit from full HP.
Pelipper.src: Most common Modest spread on the Showdown ladder (19%).

Garchomp.note: The special Mega: Levitate after Mega Evolution, so Ground moves miss it. Only one Pokémon can Mega Evolve per battle; in a four with Golisopod, whichever does it first is the Mega.
Garchomp.src: Most common Modest Mega Garchomp Z spread on the Showdown ladder (32%).

Archaludon.note: Stamina raises its Defense each time it is hit. In rain, Electro Shot fires at once and raises its Special Attack; outside rain it charges a turn first.
Archaludon.src: The most common Modest spread on the Showdown ladder, though Modest spreads are scattered (3%).

Farigiraf.note: Trick Room for the slow mode with Golisopod. Armor Tail blocks their priority moves, Fake Out included, on it and its partner.
Farigiraf.src: Most common Bold spread on the Showdown ladder (6%).

Golisopod.note: Mega Golisopod has Tough Claws, which powers up its contact moves; before it Mega Evolves, Emergency Exit switches it out below half HP. Sucker Punch only works if the target attacks. Only one Pokémon can Mega Evolve per battle; in a four with Garchomp, whichever does it first is the Mega.
Golisopod.src: Most common Adamant Mega Golisopod spread on the Showdown ladder (29%).
